3:_: All that it is. Even less than a finger. Bach, Magen Avraham:
5:_: Stands. And even if the wind does not knock it down but only shakes it, as written at the beginning of siman 362:
7:_: From plaster. And the Taz wrote: and in any case it requires that in this smearing there be some actual substance and somewhat thick, and it does not suffice with the appearance of plaster visible on the wall alone — for in any case it requires that it be thick like a cloak cord; and I saw one teacher who commanded to mark on the wall in the place of lechi with a type of white earth called kreid — and he erred greatly in this, end of his words, see there; and see in Knesset HaGedolah who raised that lechi from smeared plaster helps even for tzurat hapetach, for it requires a reed from here and a reed from here and a reed above them; if one made lechi from here and lechi from here of smeared plaster and a reed above them aligned for tzurat hapetach, see there; and so too the Taz, see there; and see in responsum of Shevut Yaakov part 2 siman 8:
8:_: From wood. For since it requires only a small measure the Sages were not strict (Tosafos). And see Taz and Yad Aharon:
21:_: And does not. And even if distant from the two walls we say lavud:
26:_: Under. The Taz wrote: it appears to me that since one must place reeds below at height ten, one need not tie the rope above on the reeds but may tie the rope even on the roof from this side and that, since the essence of tzurat hapetach is from the reeds below; also one need not beware how it is tied above on the roofs but only that the reeds stand aligned under the rope; and it appears to me further that if above the reeds placed below there is a roof interrupting between the height of the rope and the reeds there is prohibition in this, for it is not tzurat hapetach since the roof interrupts between the rope and the reeds, and we do not make tzurat hapetach in this manner except that one must open a large hole in the roof above the reeds in a manner that they are aligned under the rope without interruption; and it further appears to me that if under the rope on the wall projections extend up to ten tefachim near the ground — one may well rely on them on erev Shabbat in place of lechi reeds; and likewise the projections must be exposed above under the rope, end of his words. And see Magen Avraham and see what is written in s.k. 3:
28:_: That there is not. Meaning that its opening is not three wide even though its interior is very wide:
29:_: The sea. And in our rivers whose way is to dry greatly in summer — it is obvious that it is forbidden, Magen Avraham, see there; and in the Taz he questioned in the community of Steinitz in the land of Mehrin — they practiced moving objects on Shabbat without an eruv relying on the city being surrounded by a river around and they acquired permission from the lord — and he expanded in his analysis and ruled to forbid that they make an eruv as is customary in all communities not surrounded by a wall; however, if on the riverbank on dry land there is a place of a slope ten high over four amot as written siman 366 — we consider that slope in place of a partition, end of his words; and Magen Avraham wrote: and know that in any case we require that the sea be adjacent literally to the head of the mavo; but if it is distant from the houses ten amot correction is required, for that place is breached; and in Constantinople even though breached to the sea in several places more than ten — it is as closed, Knesset HaGedolah in the name of R' Yehuda the Castilian; and see Magen Avraham; and know that if they freeze in rainy season the partition is nullified and it is forbidden to carry; and see in responsum of Chacham Tzvi siman 37; (and see in Eben HaEzer who expanded to prove that frozen water does not nullify partitions, see there in Maginei Eretz printing Propes):
31:_: In the middle. For even one courtyard may divide thus, Rosh; and a city surrounded by a wall with doors fit to be locked except at one opening — that opening does not detract from lechi or korah and the entire city is like one mavo that has lechi at its head and one does not make eruv for half of it; and if there is a breach the qualification is nullified — and see siman 365 seif 2 — and one may qualify half and leave half; Beit Yosef siman 364, Magen Avraham:
33:_: From. In the Taz he emends that it should read: that there is more than ten from the pas to the wall, as the Tur writes, see there:
36:_: And with this. And if the entire city is surrounded by a mound and afterward they built houses in it — it is forbidden as written siman 358 seif 2, Magen Avraham; and in responsum of Emunat Shmuel siman 40 — if a ditch surrounds the city ten deep and four wide it is permitted to carry alongside it, see there; and so wrote Chacham Tzvi siman 4:
